content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty ALERT PD-6789 fired for inference-queue-prod - queue backlog > 90% and autoscaler error rate spike. Severity: P1. Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/autoscaler-backlog. Metrics: https://grafana/d/inference/queue?panelId=7

pagerduty: Page triggered by threshold: queue_length > 2000 for 5m. Escalation policy: oncall-engineering -> oncall-sre.

mia: acked. I'm the primary on-call, looking now.

sanjay: jumping in. seeing steady enqueue rate ~3200 req/s, worker pods at 100% CPU and OOMs on some. Autoscaler logs show repeated ScaleOpTimeout errors. snippet:
```
2026-03-15T09:12:01Z ERROR autoscaler: scale_op_timeout: no nodes after 3m
2026-03-15T09:12:10Z WARN autoscaler: failed to allocate resources: quotaExceeded
```

alex: quick check — are we hitting cloud provider node quota? `gcloud compute instances quotas describe --project=redwood-prod` might show. If quota, we can manual-add nodes to pool as emergency.

jess: customer-impact signal: SLO alerts for inference latency are spiking, several support tickets flagged for timeouts (~120s). Frontend error rate up ~4x for model-route /v1/generate. Notified CS.

luis: fallback option while we scale: flip traffic to lower-cost small-model variant for non-critical routes. We have a route-level policy `fallback_model: rdw-small-v1`. Can patch via API: `curl -X PATCH https://api.redwood/v1/routes/inference-prod -d '{"fallback_model":"rdw-small-v1"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'` — that will reduce per-request cpu/kvcache pressure.

mia: doing manual mitigation steps now: 1) manual scale workers +20, 2) enable fallback for non-auth routes, 3) ping infra for quota bump.

mia: manual scale command executed: `kubectl -n prod scale deployment inference-worker --replicas=120` — deployed. Logs show new pods scheduling.

sanjay: thank you. I'm tailing the queue consumer logs. seeing new pods start but kube-scheduler slow: many `failed attach` errors for volumes. Could be cloud attach limit. Will check node attach quota.

pagerduty: PD-6789 acknowledged by mia. If no ack from escalation targets in 5m, will escalate to SRE lead.

ops-rotation-bot: Paging next on-call (sre-secondary) in 4m for potential handoff: @alex.

alex: I'm oncall-secondary, available to take handoff in 6m. If quota bump doesn't land, we should prepare a partial routing cutoff for non-paying tiers.

jess: CS update: we have ~14 high-priority customer incidents open referencing timeouts. Triage suggests degraded throughput; customers reporting 50-70% of requests failing to complete.

luis: quick config to enable degraded-mode for non-SLA traffic:
```
PATCH /v1/projects/prod/config
{ "traffic_policy": { "tier_override": { "free": "degraded", "trial": "degraded" } } }
```

mia: applied fallback to `rdw-small-v1` for route group `/v1/generate?tier!=enterprise`. Confirmed traffic switch: 22% of requests now routed to fallback.

sanjay: after manual scale and fallback, queue_length dropping from 2200 -> 800 over 12m. CPU on workers down to 65%. We still see autoscaler errors in logs, but immediate pressure reduced.

pagerduty: PD-6789 status updated: acknowledged -> active mitigation. Time to mitig: 00:22.

mia: contacting cloud support for node quota increase; ticket created INC-9922. ETA unknown.

alex: proposal for short-term fix: increase autoscaler operation timeout from 3m -> 10m and retry backoff 2x. That should mitigate transient API slowness. We can patch config in `autoscaler-config` configmap. Suggest follow-up change after postmortem.

sanjay: grabbing logs for postmortem. saving `autoscaler.log` and `scheduler-events` for the 09:05-09:30 window.

luis: also recommend enabling KV-cache priming for fallback model to reduce cold-start latencies: `optimize.kv_cache.enable_priming=true` for rdw-small-v1.

mia: reassigning incident lead to alex for post-incident remediation. I'll continue to monitor for 30m then hand off. @ops-rotation-bot please page me if queue > 1000 again.

ops-rotation-bot: Hand-off scheduled: alex will take post-incident ownership at 10:00Z. Paging conditions set.

jess: CS will send customer comms template — draft ready and reviewed by legal. Sending notes to support channel.

mia: current status summary: manual scale + fallback applied, queue draining, customer impact still present but decreasing, autoscaler root cause likely quota/timeouts with cloud API. Next steps: escalate quota with cloud, patch autoscaler timeouts, enable degraded-routing automations. Opening incident ticket: INCIDENT-2026-03-A. Will create postmortem outline.

alex: thumbs for action items. I'll own the config patch and postmortem.

sanjay: attaching diagnostic links: logs: https://logs.redwood/prod/autoscaler?from=5467890000&to=5467891000, scheduler: https://logs.redwood/prod/scheduler

pagerduty: PD-6789: will auto-resolve when queue_length < 100 for 10m and no new errors from autoscaler.

mia: thanks team. monitoring. :thumbsup:
